en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Muhammad Bin Abu Hamza, from Muhammad Bin Qays, 
(It has been narrated) from one of the two (5<sup>th</sup> or 5<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>) regarding

a man who blinded an eye of a man and cut-off his ear, then killed him. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘If there was a separation between that (different times), he would be retaliated from, then he would be killed. And if he had struck him with one strike, his neck would be struck, and he would not be retaliated from’.
